|birth = {{ne|931}}}}'''Zemaille Amassa''' is an ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Zemaille din Amassa}}

== Appearance and Personality==
Zemaille is one of the [[Atha'an Miere]] and is tall and slim with a very dark complexion, straight black hair and black tattoos on her slender, graceful hands. She moved very gracefully, almost as if dancing, but seemed shy and reserved.

== Strength and Abilities==
Zemaille is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|31}}. She would be unable to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

Like all of the sisters raised from the Atha'an Miere, this is below average for an Aes Sedai, although in Zemaille's case, not significantly so. Alviarin calls her "weak", but this is not infitting with [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai#Hierarchy Judgements|other strength descriptors]].{{ref/book|10|21}} 

== History ==
Zemaille is 69 years old. She was born in the year {{ne|931}}; she went to the [[White Tower|Tower]] in {{ne|960}} claiming she was eighteen. After spending ten years as [[novice]] and ten as [[Accepted]] she was raised to the shawl in the year [[980 NE]].

She was an Accepted in the White Tower during the [[Aiel War]] and when [[Gitara Moroso]] had her [[Foretelling]] about the [[Dragon Reborn]]. [[Moiraine]] suspects that she was, for some reason, deliberately holding back, which she was. She took care not to learn too quickly in order to avoid notice.

When she went to Tar Valon, she, like the other Sea Folk sisters, kept to herself. All the Sea Folk sisters became Browns and lived on the top level of the Library. Like the others, Zemaille never put a foot wrong, abandoned all her Sea Folk jewelry and stayed away from the sea. She made friends with [[Aisling Noon]] during their studies. Like Zemaille, Aisling was also from a heritage that was unusual at the White Tower, being ''[[Tuatha'an]]''.{{ref/book|0|4}}

== Activities ==
She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She, and the other Atha'an Miere Aes Sedai ([[Nyein Kalede]] and [[Aiden Shimura]]), all work in the [[White Tower Library]] and are the secret keepers of the [[Thirteenth Depository]].

She is the first to greet [[Alviarin Freidhen]], when she returns to the Tower after a month's absence.{{ref/book|10|21}} Alviarin considers questioning and killing her, but decides not to as she notices the other Sea Folk sisters nearby.
